notes:
LeadLark Studio — small sales enablement app (B2B SMB). Inbound from self-serve signup; trialing hosted API first.

Quick summary: looking to add automatic meeting summaries + searchable transcripts into product. Primary pain: reps waste time writing notes; need fast summary + highlight customer pain points.

What they said (paraphrase / quotes):
- "We want to avoid storing sensitive PII longer than necessary."
- "Prefer hosted API to avoid ops overhead, but need clear retention policy and easy way to delete transcripts."

PII / security specifics (customer strong on this):
- transcribed data contains names, emails, customer account numbers (occasionally) and phone numbers.
- Asking: does Redwood persist raw transcripts/audio? Where and for how long? Can TTL be set per-customer?
- Wants on-the-fly PII masking/redaction or a recommended pattern (client-side redaction before send vs server-side).
- SSO for org admins (SAML) required for console access later. SOC2 is baseline.

Technical constraints & preferences:
- Hosted API only for initial POC (no VPC/Dedicated right now).
- Throughput small: 30-200 calls/day; latency sensitive for realtime summary (aim <1s token generation for short recaps).
- Cost sensitive: careful about token burn; interested in optimize recommendations (batching, cache, quantization guidance for later).
- Model preference: open-models or verified smaller LMs to start (cost/latency tradeoffs).

POC plan discussed:
- 2-week trial using hosted API and free credits.
- Deliverable: integrate summary endpoint into web app + show automated summary for 20 trial meetings.
- Success metrics: 70% of summaries accepted by reps; mean time saved >= 5 min/rep/meeting.

Sales / commercial notes:
- Estimated ARR small (5k-20k). Likely self-serve upgrade if POC succeeds.
- Early decision maker: Head of Product (Lina Morales). Technical buyer: Eng Lead (Tom Iskander).

Action items / next steps:
- Send Redwood security FAQ + SOC2 summary (done 2026-03-01). Link: drive:/security/leadlark-reqs-20260226.docx.
- Provide sample retention TTL options + delete API example (requested 2026-03-04).
- Schedule POC walkthrough with SE (Derek) week of 2026-03-08.

Blockers: clarity on PII retention default + UI to request deletion; need simple documented pattern for redaction.

Misc: referenced competitor Fireflies during call; migrating some customers from legacy meeting notes tool. Friendly tone, startup-y.
use_case_summary: SMB sales enablement: hosted API for call summaries + searchable transcripts. PII sensitive; wants TTL/delete APIs and SSO for admin console. Cost-conscious, small throughput, self-serve upgrade path.
